salvageable_components.item_name: stainless steel handrail with curved profile
salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove by unscrewing or unbolting mounting brackets; inspect for weld integrity and surface corrosion; clean with mild detergent and stainless steel polish for reuse.

salvageable_components.item_name: frameless glass door with metal edge trim
salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Carefully remove glass panel by releasing gaskets and lifting vertically; inspect for edge chipping or scratches; store flat to prevent stress fractures.

salvageable_components.item_name: paved stone flooring with metal grating

technical_features.connection_type: mortared or bedded in sand, grating secured with clips or welds

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove grating by cutting or prying fasteners; stone pavers can be lifted with pry bar and reused if intact; separate metal and stone for recycling.

salvageable_components.item_name: white metal display stand with glass top
salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Disassemble by removing bolts; inspect for coating damage; sand and repaint if needed; glass top can be reused if undamaged.

hazard_and_diagnostic_flags: Verify presence of lead-based paint on metal components prior to sanding or cutting; test for VOCs in adhesives or sealants used in glass gaskets; inspect grating for galvanic corrosion if in contact with dissimilar metals.
